findings.evidence: `Units.index_posSubgroup` in `Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Ring/Units.lean:15` already has the generic ordered-ring signature, while lines 134–137 use only `QuotientGroup.ker_mk'`, `MonoidHom.comap_ker`, and finite quotient inference, none of which uses `K` as a field or number field.
findings.fix: State the positive-subgroup instance for any `[Ring R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R]`, and the comap instance for any group `G` and homomorphism `G →* Rˣ`; then specialize them implicitly in `finiteIndex_totallyPositiveUnits`.
findings.issue: Both new supporting instances are under-generalized: the first fixes `ℝ`, and `instFiniteIndexComapPosSubgroup` additionally fixes the source to `Kˣ` under `[Field K] [NumberField K]`, although neither restriction is used by the argument.

summary: The supporting finite-index API is unnecessarily specialized to real units and number-field unit groups despite proofs that work at the general ordered-ring/group level.
